Question: What happened on your first day at IIT?
Answer: It was 27 Oct. 2022, probably the day about which I was dreaming for 2 years, sometimes while sleeping and sometimes with open eyes. Tbvh, I never ever thought that I'll be here some day, It was just a dream but sometimes, dreams do come true. I reached Borivali station at 8:30 Am after completing a 17hr long train journey from Delhi. I was travelling with one my brother, 1st year medical student and one cousin, final year medical student. On the first day itself, I encountered Mumbai Traffic🤧 Combining everything, I reached campus at 10 Am and we directly moved to hostel from there. Literally, the feel was on next level, can't be described in some words. Time ~ 10:15 Am, Reached H16, Olympus We reached H16 , we saw a girl coming towards us, later realising she was a part of ISMP ( Institute Student Mentorship Program), and later on another mentor come, fuck him!, he asked me to join orientation (when I was near H16) saying that it is very important. I was feeling very hungry that time plus there were some other problems too, I wanted to be in hostel but that guy made me to join orientation. We earlier planned to had lunch in restaurant, but that mentor broke our plan🥲 Time ~ 10:25 Am, I entered convocation hall. Damn boring, a boy right to me was sleeping, in only 25 Mins. I didn't slept during it. Morning Orientation (Started at 10 Am) ended somewhere around 2:30 Pm and some seniors asked us to be present here at 3:30 Pm again after having lunch. I reached hostel 16 around 3 Am, took a bath, went for mess. My Room is B213, koi campus se ho to aa jana🙂 Saw some stranger in mess eating next to me, after talking to him, I realised he is AIR 44 and is a CSE student, huge respect for him came spontaneously within me. (Btw I talked to him and realised he was preparing from 8th) It was already 4 Pm and both of my brothers didn't allowed me to attend evening session of orientation. Then we went to purchase matress and all other stuff and set up the room It was around 5 Pm My brothers left me, as they had nothing to do in the campus. They left me within a bunch of strangers saying Ja ab tu iitb ka student hai. I was very alone, for the first time in my life and tears were almost out of eye but I somehow managed. I knew no one here, atleast in 700km radius. My room mate too already had went for evening orientation. I was literally very alone but idk how A guy entered my room, he has a sophie friend in the campus, we then explored campus till 7 Pm. Then, I went for mess. And later, I realised I missed evening orientation, where we had course registration and an English and Basic Computer test. I was really very tensed as someone said today (27) was last date and you missed it. Mai bata nahi sakta ki mai uss time kitna Dara hua tha🥲 Then we had a 2hr meet with our ISMP mentor, Himanshu Damani Bhaiya, he said that registration is not a big issue, he'll handle it all. Fir thoda relaxed laga😅 Then, around 9:30 Pm, I got a text from my friend whom I get to know through IITB WA group, Haren, AIR 40. I Met him. Around 10 Pm, I met @Celtao123 ,3rd admin of my Quora space. It was fun meeting him as it was first time I was meeting someone through Quora. You won't beleive but we were talking about Quora only😂 Some Random Shot Of H1, The Queen We roamed freely in the campus and then I went to my room around 11 Am. Slept then. Later I relaised semester registration is not a big issue, i did that using my mobile in just 5 mins and i attempted that test too on 29. That's how my first day at IIT Bombay was, literally everything included. Thanks.

Question: How did you solve your doubts while preparing for the JEE through YouTube?
Answer: Doubts, This is the part where JEE through YouTube sucks! Disclaimer : This might be demotivating for students preparing through YouTube, but this is what it is…. First of all, I personally used to spend more time in theory (than regular students) so that I'll get fewer doubts. This thing works. Also, I used to give decent time in doing derivations. Derivations teach how to interlink concepts. Still, Whenever I get a doubt, I used these ways (orderly)….. I) Referring to the solution given by resource. II) Googling Doubt. You can't google OC structures and mathematical expressions. And sometimes, Google too don't know the solution. Some of my doubts (10–15% of all) remained doubt and combined into self-doubt. They were not clear as I never get satisfactory reason for them. That's why I'll always recommend joining offline if you can. Ed-tech giants came up with the solutions, like Unacademy plus, PW Saarthi and Filo but…. these are out of reach for those who are studying from YouTube. But don't worry, JEE is 90% your efforts and 10% that of institute. You can get decent rank with YouTube also. But If you're targeting higher rank, sorry dude, that 10% also matters there…. which is 0 incase of YouTube. Thanks for your time and sorry for demotivation.

Question: What is the one thing you regret in your JEE prep and want to warn juniors about?
Answer: Well, try to stay till the end. You'll definitely learn something. After my JEE Mains, I was fuzked up, exhausted, tired…..couldn't focus on Advanced or maybe these are just excuses, i didn't even tried … tbh I don't know. Between Mains and Advanced, I hardly studied that much a JEE Aspirant is supposed to do. 1 week prior to JEE Advanced, I left hope with JEE Advanced, finalized that I'll be joining IIIT Allahabad. In my Pre-Advanced Quora Posts, I had written that I'll be joining IIITA IT. Even in Mathongo's AYJR (Advanced), my score was 72 (out of 420 ig) with predicted rank around 25K. I cried 3 days before exam (for 2 hour, slept that day crying ig) for not studying in those 2 months, thinking about my IIT dream… but i accepted the reality… that I never deserved it….. Now i have no stress, no anxiety, nothing to lose… cuz I had lost it already. And All this was turning point….. Attempted Paper (Without Stress n anxiety)…….. Got 5051 CRL, Enough to Enter Old IITs. My Regret : I didn't studied between mains and advanced. But wait… Is it necessary that studying always improves rank? Maybe not, something called stable temperament during exams is too an important factor. Learning For You : Your mindset, handling tension and stress during exams somewhat matters more than your preparation. Don't think much about about result, especially while giving the exam. Question: How different is JEE Mains from JEE Advanced?
Answer: Imagine two cases, first is travelling from Delhi to Hyderabad and second is travelling from Delhi to Bangalore. When you look at the journey, both seems same i.e., travelling to South India. In the start, you have to travel by the same road. But after a certain distance, you have to change path. And then you'll realise, they are very different. Similar is the case with JEE Mains and JEE Advanced. Initial things are same for both like understanding the concept, doing derivations, learning to apply formulae. But after this, You have to set different mindset for JEE Mains and JEE Advanced. Questions JEE Mains asks you to solve easier questions (2022 Maths smiling) JEE Advanced asks tough questions with lengthy calculations. Time JEE Advanced F**ks for twice the time as JEE Mains do. JEE Advanced and JEE Advanced gives you the opportunity to different types of institutes. It requires same preparation but doing different things for Mains and doing different things for Advanced. Competition Well, as per me, competition wise JEE Mains > JEE Advanced as more people tend to do easier things which make easier thing competitive. At the end, both are same i.e., travelling to South India no, they both are engineering entrances, but with different flavours. Leaving Here, Vansh Yadav

Question: Is a digitally signed OBC NCL certificate accepted in the JoSAA council?
Answer: Let me clear each and every doubt regarding OBC NCL certificate here in this post. Let me show you mine accepted by IIT Bombay. Clearly, it is not in the JoSAA Format. I know what doubts you have, i too had same untill mine was verified, I'll try to clarify each of them. First of all, digitally signed certificates are accepted everywhere and JoSAA is no exception. If your certificate is not in the JoSAA Format, then it will be accepted given that it is made after 1 April of the same year taking admission and obviously, it should be valid. Format doesn't matter much. I also had conversation with students from Jharkhand and Maharashtra, their certificates were in different format, but accepted by respective institutes. The reason JoSAA had a certificate format is that every state has their own format and to prevent the bullshit, it made a format. Whatever state you live in, just go through its site and apply online. What I did was, paid 200 bucks to a cyber cafe and he did everything, you can try the same. If you want in JoSAA format. Then, print the format and reach out to govt. office and get them signed but I'll prefer using the way told in above paragraph. If you still have doubts, comment them! Leaving Here, Vansh Yadav

Question: What are the common mistakes while preparing for IIT JEE?
Answer: Not analysing mock test. Kal kar lunga Getting distracted. Quitting in the middle. Yaar, chod deta hu wese bhi konsa apna iit hona hai. Overthinking. Agar mera IIT Bombay nahi hua to IITM lunga, nahi IITD lunga. Nah, mai to IIITH lunga😎 Not resolving their doubts. Yaar, agar mai ye doubt poochlunga, tu ye sab mere baare me kya sochenge😑 Ignoring NCERT (For Chemistry too) NCERT to cbse walo ke liye hai, hum to IIT Bombay wale hain. Using multiple books Jitne zada books, utne zada number😁 Not revising regularly. Kal hi to padha tha, kya revise karna. Not making short notes. Internet se download karke use kar lunga. Skipping derivations. Hatt bc, Jee objective hai to derivations kyu Karu. Falling in love with him/her and wasting time over him/her. Yaar, bas wo bura na Maan jae, baaki padhai to mai sambhaal lunga. Watching YouTube Startegy Video. Most Important : Not Maintaining Consistency Kal karlunga, ek din me mai kahi IITIAN na banra. Spending time on out of syllabus things Physics mera passion hai, aur passion ka koi syllabus nahi hota😎 Wasting free time in school Agar mai inke saamne padhne laga, to ye kya sochenge mere baare me. Excess screen time. Thinking that, Theory > Practice. Not upvoting such posts Not following me. Ab kar bhi do na yaar🥺 That's it. Leaving Here, Vansh Yadav
